name: Cloak Probe (research)
description: Research for an invisibility ability. Ctrl+F12 once: fades your Helldiver's own materials (opacity, opacity_stealth). Ctrl+F12 again: hides every mesh of every part. Shift+F12 undoes it all. F12 logs the engine's mesh and material calls and the nearest Stalker's. Also logs every explosion near you. Needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Host or solo. Turn off when done.
